pages.title: Our Story
pages.body:
Parkdale Brass began in [2019] in [Toronto's Parkdale neighbourhood] with an appreciation for brass and the industrial design of everyday objects. Today, we're taking that same interest in form, function and character into jewelry. Our next chapter is about pieces that feel personal, with warm tones, considered shapes and a style that doesn't need to shout.

[Founder: name the founder here only if the owner confirms it in writing (B-05). Otherwise remove this line.]

[Est. 2019 refers to the brand, not the jewelry line. Add nothing about where or how the jewelry is made unless the owner verifies it (C-06).]

pages.title: Why Brass?
pages.body:
What brass is

Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc, prized for its warm tone and the way it takes a finish.

[The alloy in our jewelry, from supplier documentation only (C-02).]

Raw, coated and plated

Uncoated brass darkens and softens with wear. Coated and plated finishes behave differently.

[How each finish we offer wears, and whether it patinas. Only the finishes actually offered (C-03).]

Every piece lists its actual finish and how to care for it, so you know how it will change.

Patina and skin discolouration

[Owner-approved copy on patina and skin discolouration. Include a note to stop wearing a piece if irritation develops. Green skin isn't proof of safety, or of harm.]
